test_cases.question: What is the European Data Protection Board and what is its legal status?
test_cases.answer: The European Data Protection Board (the 'Board') is hereby established as a body of the Union and shall have legal personality. The Board shall be represented by its Chair.
test_cases.supporting_quote: The European Data Protection Board (the 'Board') is hereby established as a body of the Union and shall have legal personality. The Board shall be represented by its Chair

test_cases.question: Who are the members of the European Data Protection Board?
test_cases.answer: The Board shall be composed of the head of one supervisory authority of each Member State and of the European Data Protection Supervisor, or their respective representatives.
test_cases.supporting_quote: The Board shall be composed of the head of one supervisory authority of each Member State and of the European Data Protection Supervisor, or their respective representatives

test_cases.question: What happens when a Member State has more than one supervisory authority?
test_cases.answer: Where in a Member State more than one supervisory authority is responsible for monitoring the application of GDPR provisions, a joint representative shall be appointed in accordance with that Member State's law.
test_cases.supporting_quote: Where in a Member State more than one supervisory authority is responsible for monitoring the application of the provisions pursuant to this Regulation, a joint representative shall be appointed in accordance with that Member State's law

test_cases.question: Can the European Commission vote on Board decisions?
test_cases.answer: No. The Commission shall have the right to participate in the activities and meetings of the Board without voting right. The Commission shall designate a representative, and the Chair shall communicate Board activities to the Commission.
test_cases.supporting_quote: The Commission shall have the right to participate in the activities and meetings of the Board without voting right. The Commission shall designate a representative. The Chair of the Board shall communicate the activities of the Board to the Commission

b2b_relevance: MEDIUM - Article 68 establishes the EDPB, which: (1) Issues binding decisions affecting your cross-border cases, (2) Provides guidance and opinions on GDPR interpretation, (3) Maintains consistency across EU. Key takeaway: EDPB is a Union body with real authority (legal personality), not just a discussion forum.
